system_name: End-of-Life Vehicle (ELV) Dismantling & Shredding — Cut-off Approach
dismantling_process: Depollution (fluids, battery, tyres, catalyst removal), dismantling, shredding, magnetic/eddy-current separation
notes: Under Cut-off allocation, secondary materials enter manufacturing with their recycled production factor (e.g. 0.5–2.5 kg CO2e/kg for secondary Al), and no avoided-burden credit is subtracted at EoL to prevent double-counting.

system_name: Lithium-Ion Traction Battery End-of-Life Hydrometallurgical / Pyrometallurgical Recycling
applicable_material_or_vehicle: Battery Electric (BEV) / PHEV / HEV Traction Battery Pack
